@GJC1979 I found this error is due to install `msmpi` before installing `netcdf-c`. Could you use the attached files instead of _VCPKG_ROOT/ports/netcdf-c_ and install `netcdf-c` again? This is a upstream bug. If you can use the attached files install `netcdf-c` succeed, could you please submit an issue on [upstream](https://github.com/Unidata/netcdf-c)? 
[netcdf-c.zip](https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/files/7773714/netcdf-c.zip)
